ucs.title: [LLM] APT29/Midnight Blizzard OAuth illicit-consent + service-principal credential addition
ucs.description: Hunts APT29's signature post-compromise Entra ID tradecraft: adding credentials (secrets/certs) to existing privileged service principals or OAuth applications to maintain stealthy, MFA-bypassing access to Microsoft Graph mail/file APIs. This is the exact technique used in the 2024 Microsoft corporate breach and the SolarWinds-era cloud pivot.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (nodename=All_Changes.Account_Management OR All_Changes.object_category="service_principal" OR All_Changes.object_category="application") (All_Changes.action="modified" OR All_Changes.action="created") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.object All_Changes.object_category All_Changes.command All_Changes.src All_Changes.result | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | search (command IN ("Update application*Certificates and secrets management","Update service principal*","Add service principal credentials","Update application*","Consent to application") OR object_category IN ("ServicePrincipal","Application")) | join type=outer user [| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.app="Microsoft Graph" by Authentication.user Authentication.src | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename count as graph_signins, src as graph_src] | where graph_signins > 0 OR command LIKE "%Consent to application%" | eval risk_score=if(match(command,"(?i)credential|secret|certificate"),90,60) | table firstTime, lastTime, user, object, command, src, graph_src, risk_score | convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime) | sort - risk_score
ucs.kql:
// APT29/Midnight Blizzard — illicit OAuth consent + SP credential add → Graph data exfil
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let HighRiskApps = dynamic(["Microsoft Graph","Office 365 Exchange Online","Office 365 SharePoint Online","Azure Active Directory Graph"]);
let CredOrConsentOps = dynamic([
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application Certificates and secrets management",
    "Update application",
    "Consent to application",
    "Add delegated permission grant",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal",
    "Add owner to application",
    "Add owner to service principal"
]);
let SuspiciousChanges = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in ("Office 365","Microsoft Azure AD","Microsoft Entra ID")
    | where ActionType in (CredOrConsentOps)
    | extend TargetApp = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)
    | project ChangeTime = Timestamp, AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName,
              IPAddress, CountryCode, ISP, UserAgent, ActionType, TargetApp, RawEventData;
let GraphAccess = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in (HighRiskApps) or ResourceDisplayName in (HighRiskApps)
    | where TokenIssuerType == "AzureAD"
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, IPAddress,
              Country, AppDisplayName, ResourceDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent;
SuspiciousChanges
| join kind=inner GraphAccess on AccountObjectId
| where SignInTime between (ChangeTime - 24h .. ChangeTime + 7d)
| extend GeoMismatch = iff(CountryCode != Country and isnotempty(Country), true, false)
| extend NonInteractive = iff(ClientAppUsed has_any ("Other clients","Mobile Apps and Desktop clients"), true, false)
| summarize ChangeOps = make_set(ActionType, 10),
            Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
            SrcIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 20),
            Countries = make_set(CountryCode, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(ChangeTime),
            LastSeen = max(SignInTime),
            EventCount = count()
        by AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName, TargetApp
| where EventCount > 0
| extend Severity = case(
    array_length(ChangeOps) >= 2 and array_length(Apps) >= 2, "High",
    array_length(ChangeOps) >= 1, "Medium",
    "Low")
| order by Severity asc, LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT29/Midnight Blizzard — Entra ID SP credential add + post-change OAuth token use
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CredOps = dynamic([
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application Certificates and secrets management",
    "Update application",
    "Consent to application",
    "Add delegated permission grant",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal",
    "Add owner to application",
    "Add owner to service principal"
]);
let HighRiskResources = dynamic(["Microsoft Graph","Office 365 Exchange Online","Office 365 SharePoint Online"]);
let CredChanges = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Category in ("ApplicationManagement","ServicePrincipalManagement","DirectoryManagement")
    | where OperationName in (CredOps)
    | extend Initiator = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend InitiatorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | extend TargetApp = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    | extend TargetAppId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
    | project ChangeTime = TimeGenerated, Initiator, InitiatorIP, OperationName, TargetApp, TargetAppId, Result;
let SPGraphUse = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResourceDisplayName in (HighRiskResources)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | project SPSignInTime = TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId,
              SPIPAddress = IPAddress, SPResource = ResourceDisplayName;
CredChanges
| join kind=leftouter SPGraphUse on $left.TargetAppId == $right.ServicePrincipalId
| where isnull(SPSignInTime) or SPSignInTime between (ChangeTime .. ChangeTime + 7d)
| extend NewIPPostChange = iff(isnotempty(SPIPAddress) and SPIPAddress != InitiatorIP, true, false)
| summarize Ops = make_set(OperationName),
            ResourcesAccessed = make_set(SPResource),
            SPSrcIPs = make_set(SPIPAddress),
            Initiators = make_set(Initiator),
            InitiatorIPs = make_set(InitiatorIP),
            FirstChange = min(ChangeTime),
            LastSPUse = max(SPSignInTime)
        by TargetApp, TargetAppId
| extend Severity = case(
    array_length(Ops) >= 2 and array_length(ResourcesAccessed) >= 1, "High",
    array_length(Ops) >= 1, "Medium",
    "Low")
| order by FirstChange desc

ucs.title: [LLM] APT29 WINELOADER/ROOTSAW HTML-smuggling → ISO/LNK → rundll32 sideload chain
ucs.description: Hunts APT29's recurring spear-phishing chain (ROOTSAW HTA dropper → ISO/IMG container → LNK → signed-binary DLL sideload of WINELOADER/BURNTBATTER), observed in the 2024 diplomatic-mission and German political-party campaigns. Pivots on the characteristic browser→archive→mounted-ISO→rundll32/sideload tree that this actor relies on.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.iso" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.img" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhd" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.zip") Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Downloads\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest as host, process_id as drop_pid | join type=inner host [| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","outlook.exe","explorer.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host, process as suspicious_cmd, _time as exec_time] | where exec_time >= firstTime AND exec_time <= (lastTime + 1800) | search (suspicious_cmd="*sqlwriter*" OR suspicious_cmd="*vmtools*" OR suspicious_cmd="*\\D:\\*" OR suspicious_cmd="*\\E:\\*" OR suspicious_cmd="*\\F:\\*" OR match(suspicious_cmd,"(?i)\.(dll|cpl|ocx),\s*\w+")) | stats values(file_name) as containers values(suspicious_cmd) as cmds values(process_name) as exec_method min(firstTime) as first_seen max(exec_time) as last_seen count by host user | convert ctime(first_seen), ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// APT29 WINELOADER / ROOTSAW — browser-delivered ISO/IMG → LNK → rundll32 sideload chain
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let Containers = dynamic([".iso",".img",".vhd",".vhdx",".zip",".rar"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
let ContainerDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (Browsers)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\INetCache\")
    | where FileName has_any (Containers)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, ContainerName = FileName,
              ContainerPath = FolderPath,
              SourceUrl = FileOriginUrl,
              ContainerSHA256 = SHA256;
let SideloadExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (LolBins)
           or (FileName !endswith ".exe" and isnotempty(FileName))
           or FolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ dynamic(["explorer.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe"])
      or InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dll|cpl|ocx)[\s,\"]"
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sqlwriter","vmtools","OneDriveStandaloneUpdater","WerFault","AppLaunch")
         or FolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildSHA = SHA256,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName;
ContainerDrops
| join kind=inner SideloadExec on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 30m)
| extend ExecutionDelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, ExecTime, ExecutionDelaySec, DeviceName,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, SourceUrl, ContainerName,
          ChildImage, ChildCmd, ParentImage, ChildSHA, ContainerSHA256
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT29 ROOTSAW/WINELOADER chain — Sentinel cross-table via ASIM
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let Containers = dynamic([".iso",".img",".vhd",".vhdx",".zip"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe"]);
let ContainerDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (Browsers)
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\")
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("iso","img","vhd","vhdx","zip")
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ContainerName = TargetFileName, ContainerHash = TargetFileSHA256;
let Sideload = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (LolBins) or TargetProcessName has_any (LolBins)
    | where ParentProcessName has_any (dynamic(["explorer.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe"]))
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dll|cpl|ocx)[\s,\"]"
         or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("sqlwriter","vmtools","WerFault")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ChildCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine, ChildName = TargetProcessName,
              ParentName = ParentProcessName;
ContainerDrops
| join kind=inner Sideload on DvcHostname
| where ExecTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 30m)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ContainerName, ChildName, ChildCmd, ParentName, ContainerHash
| order by ExecTime desc
